'''Plexgrove Combine''' was a financial and [[Bank/Legends|banking]] conglomerate that offered low- and mid-level services throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The conglomerate had a reputation for making profitable investments and for helping business-beings and home owners with its tailored customer service beyond expectation. Plexgrove designed the banking and [[Currency/Legends|currency]] systems used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and oversaw those financial services not undertaken by the [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]].<ref name="HSCS" />

Plexgrove Combine was one of numerous companies to provide the equivalent of fifty trillion [[Credit chip/Legends|credits]] in equipment, funds, and services to become one of the Corporate Sector Authority's original [[contributing sponsor]]s, receiving nominal discounts on bulk goods and raw material and a proportional share of [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] profits.<ref name="HSCS" /> By around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="HSCSinterviewDate">Interviews with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] in ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'' note a recent interaction between her and [[Salla Zend]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. That interaction occurs in ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'', which also depicts Organa Solo subsequently and directly traveling to the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] and [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates those events to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], and as such, the interviews and information in the sourcebook presented as "current" must occur following the [[Battle of Calamari|events]] on Mon Calamari and thus around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the company was upgraded to be a [[voting sponsor]], receiving increased profits, larger discounts, and unrestricted access to the employees of the Authority.<ref name="HSCS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Plexgrove Combine was first mentioned in the [[1993]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Michael Allen Horne]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HSCS" />
